title: Account locked after repeated sign-in attempts
description: User cannot sign in after several failed password attempts and reports an account lockout message.
diagnosis: Confirmed the identity was locked in the simulated directory state; no evidence of a wider authentication outage.
commandsAndTools: Identity lifecycle simulation in WhatIf mode
rootCause: Stale credentials in a fictional mail client caused repeated failed attempts.
resolution: Validated identity, simulated unlock workflow and instructed the user to update the saved credential.
userValidation: User sign-in test recorded as successful in the scenario.
prevention: Add cached-credential guidance to the sign-in knowledge article.
closureCommunication: Your account lockout scenario has been resolved. Please update saved credentials before retrying sign-in. Reply if the issue returns.

title: MFA challenge unavailable
description: User reports that the registered MFA method is not producing a usable challenge.
diagnosis: Separated device/time-sync troubleshooting from account recovery; no bypass was attempted.
evidence: MFA failure reproduced in the scenario
rootCause: Fictional test device had notifications disabled.
resolution: Validated alternate approved method and documented re-registration under controlled recovery.
userValidation: User completed a test challenge in the scenario.
prevention: Publish MFA recovery steps and require a second approved method.
closureCommunication: Your MFA access has been restored using the approved recovery process. Please keep a second method registered.

title: Device marked non-compliant
description: User cannot access a protected resource because the endpoint is reported as non-compliant.
diagnosis: Health model identified a failed mandatory control; the issue was not treated as a user password problem.
rootCause: Simulated device check-in was older than the defined compliance window.
resolution: Refreshed the simulated health record and escalated the policy-sync dependency.
userValidation: Protected resource access restored in the scenario after the simulated refresh.
prevention: Add stale check-in monitoring and a first-line refresh procedure.
closureCommunication: The device compliance scenario has been corrected and access restored. Contact support if the device becomes non-compliant again.

title: Approved corporate application not installed
description: User requests installation of an approved CRM helper application on a managed Windows device.
diagnosis: Confirmed application is approved and device is in the correct target group; no admin rights were granted to the user.
rootCause: Device was not assigned to the application deployment group in the simulation.
resolution: Added the fictional device to the approved target and recorded a deployment validation.
userValidation: Application launch test passed in the scenario.
prevention: Add application assignment to the onboarding checklist.
closureCommunication: The approved application has been assigned and validated. It is now available on your managed device.

title: DNS resolution failure for internal resource
description: User can browse public sites but cannot resolve the fictional internal finance resource.
diagnosis: Compared public and internal name resolution and isolated the issue to the internal DNS path.
rootCause: Fictional internal DNS record was absent from the scenario dataset.
resolution: Corrected the simulated record and flushed the client resolver cache.
userValidation: Internal resource resolved and loaded in the scenario.
prevention: Add DNS record ownership and change validation to the runbook.
closureCommunication: The internal resource is resolving again. The issue was isolated to the fictional internal DNS record.

title: VPN connection fails from remote location
description: Remote user cannot establish the approved VPN connection and has a time-sensitive quality review.
diagnosis: Validated internet reachability first, then separated client configuration from gateway availability.
rootCause: Fictional VPN profile had expired configuration metadata.
resolution: Reissued the simulated profile through the approved process and validated connection.
userValidation: User reached the fictional internal resource in the scenario.
prevention: Track profile expiry and add renewal notification.
closureCommunication: Your VPN profile has been renewed and the connection test passed. Please report any recurrence with the exact time and error.

title: Incorrect access to a restricted resource
description: A standard user can see a restricted workspace that is outside the expected access profile.
diagnosis: Reviewed effective group membership against the access matrix and checked recent mover activity.
rootCause: A stale department group remained after an internal move.
resolution: Removed obsolete access, retained the new approved profile and recorded a review task.
userValidation: Restricted resource no longer appears in the scenario.
prevention: Require mover access comparison and quarterly group review.
closureCommunication: The unexpected access was removed and your approved access remains unchanged. The access review has been recorded.

title: Onboarding for new study coordinator
description: Approved request to prepare identity, groups, device and application checklist for a new fictional joiner.
diagnosis: Validated manager, department and Standard-User access profile against the access matrix.
rootCause: No fault; this was a standard fulfilment request.
resolution: Created the simulated identity state and completed the onboarding checklist.
userValidation: Manager confirmed the checklist and required access in the scenario.
prevention: Use a standard onboarding form with mandatory fields.
closureCommunication: The onboarding request is complete in the lab scenario. The identity, access profile and device checklist were validated with the manager.

title: Urgent offboarding after same-day departure
description: Manager requests immediate removal of access for a fictional leaver with a same-day departure.
diagnosis: Confirmed authorised request and treated it as a security-sensitive lifecycle event.
rootCause: No technical fault; urgent approved leaver process was required.
resolution: Disabled the fictional identity, recorded session revocation and initiated device/resource handover steps.
userValidation: Manager confirmed access was removed in the scenario.
prevention: Maintain a pre-approved leaver escalation path and asset register.
closureCommunication: The urgent offboarding steps have been completed in the lab scenario and the manager has confirmed the handover actions.

title: Multiple users cannot access Microsoft 365 services
description: Several fictional users report simultaneous inability to access core collaboration services.
diagnosis: Correlated reports by time and service before changing any individual account.
resolution: Opened major incident coordination, issued user communications and closed after service recovery was recorded.
userValidation: Five affected users confirmed access restoration in the scenario.
prevention: Maintain status communication templates and a major incident timeline.
closureCommunication: The major incident scenario is resolved. Access was restored for the affected users; the timeline and follow-up actions have been recorded.
